eval_dimensions.name: Phase 0 Spec-Compliance BLOCKED Escalation
eval_dimensions.description: When the spec-reviewer subagent returns BLOCKED (FAIL_SCOPE / FAIL_MISSING / FAIL_OVER), the skill fires AskUserQuestion (Address spec gap first / Continue review anyway) before running Step 2+ — it never silently continues review on a failed spec check.

eval_dimensions.name: Zero-Findings Confirmation Gate (GH-447 F5)
eval_dimensions.description: In attended mode, even when zero findings are produced, the skill fires AskUserQuestion to confirm the clean review rather than silently skipping through. The gate is exempted only when invoked with --unattended (GH-760 F6).

eval_dimensions.name: Findings-Present Disposition Gate
eval_dimensions.description: When findings > 0 in attended mode, the skill fires AskUserQuestion (Fix all / Pick findings / Skip) before invoking Dev10x:review-fix — findings are never auto-fixed without user disposition in attended mode.

eval_dimensions.name: Unattended Confidence-Threshold Filtering
eval_dimensions.description: In unattended mode, only findings with confidence >= threshold (default 70) AND severity ERROR/WARNING are passed to Dev10x:review-fix; below-threshold findings are logged as INFO, not silently dropped or auto-fixed.

evals.name: spec-reviewer BLOCKED verdict fires the escalation gate
evals.description: When the Phase 0 spec-reviewer subagent's trailing status line is BLOCKED, the skill must stop and ask before running automated checks or per-file review.

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion fires with 'Address spec gap first (Recommended)' / 'Continue review anyway' options
No inline 'spec looks off, should I continue?' text substitutes for the widget
Step 2 (automated checks) does NOT run before the gate resolves

evals.name: DONE_WITH_CONCERNS continues without a gate but queues the concern
evals.description: A PARTIAL spec verdict continues to Step 2 directly (no AskUserQuestion) but records the concern as a WARNING/spec finding in the final summary.

assertions.signal: No AskUserQuestion fires for DONE_WITH_CONCERNS; review proceeds to Step 2 and the concern appears as a WARNING finding with source=spec in the final summary

evals.name: Zero findings still fires AskUserQuestion in attended mode
evals.description: A clean review (0 findings) in attended (default) mode must still confirm via AskUserQuestion — it does not silently report done.

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion fires with 'Continue (Recommended)' / 'Re-review' options even though findings=0
No inline 'looks clean, want to continue?' text substitutes for the widget

evals.name: --unattended exempts the zero-findings gate
evals.description: When invoked with --unattended (e.g. from work-on's shipping pipeline), a clean review auto-advances without firing AskUserQuestion (GH-760 F6).

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion is NOT called when --unattended is set, even at 0 findings; the skill auto-advances

evals.name: Findings > 0 in attended mode fires the disposition gate
evals.description: When the review produces at least one finding in attended mode, AskUserQuestion fires with Fix all / Pick findings / Skip before Dev10x:review-fix is invoked.

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion fires with 'Fix all (Recommended)' / 'Pick findings' / 'Skip' options
No inline 'want me to fix these findings?' text substitutes for the widget
Skill(Dev10x:review-fix) is NOT invoked before the gate resolves

evals.name: Unattended mode filters findings by confidence before fixing
evals.description: In unattended mode, only findings with confidence >= 70 (default) and severity ERROR/WARNING reach Dev10x:review-fix; below-threshold findings are logged as INFO.

assertions.signal: Only the two confidence>=70 findings are passed to Dev10x:review-fix; the confidence=40 finding appears as INFO in the summary, not sent to the fixer

trigger_evals.description: Queries that should/should-not trigger the review skill

should_trigger.rationale: Direct invocation — attended self-review of the current branch

should_trigger.query: review my changes before I open a PR
should_trigger.rationale: Pre-PR self-review — the core use case

should_not_trigger.query: my branch has no commits yet
should_not_trigger.rationale: Nothing to review — no diff exists against base
